name: dialog
title: Dialog
author: Pluto Systems <https://github.com/plutosystemsco/design-system>
description: A modal window named by its title, behind the scrim, for a task that must finish before the page goes on.

files.content:
<script lang="ts">
  import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from "bits-ui";

  let { open = $bindable(false), ...restProps }: DialogPrimitive.RootProps =
    $props();
</script>

<DialogPrimitive.Root bind:open {...restProps} />

<script lang="ts">
  import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from "bits-ui";

  let { ref = $bindable(null), ...restProps }: DialogPrimitive.TriggerProps =
    $props();
</script>

<!-- bits-ui names it: aria-haspopup="dialog", aria-expanded, aria-controls. -->
<DialogPrimitive.Trigger bind:ref data-slot="dialog-trigger" {...restProps} />

{#snippet child({ props })}
{@render children?.()} {#if showCloseButton} {#snippet child({ props })} {/snippet} {/if}
{/snippet}

<script lang="ts">
  import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
  import { cn } from "$UTILS$";

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    ...restProps
  }: DialogPrimitive.OverlayProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- The scrim, unblurred, fading with the content. -->
<DialogPrimitive.Overlay
  bind:ref
  data-slot="dialog-overlay"
  class={cn(
    "fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-scrim data-open:animate-enter data-closed:animate-exit",
    className,
  )}
  {...restProps}
/>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from "bits-ui";

  let { ...restProps }: DialogPrimitive.PortalProps = $props();
</script>

<DialogPrimitive.Portal {...restProps} />

<script lang="ts">
  import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from "bits-ui";

  let { ref = $bindable(null), ...restProps }: DialogPrimitive.CloseProps =
    $props();
</script>

<DialogPrimitive.Close bind:ref data-slot="dialog-close" {...restProps} />
{@render children?.()}
{@render children?.()} {#if showCloseButton} {#snippet child({ props })} {/snippet} {/if}

<script lang="ts">
  import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
  import { cn } from "$UTILS$";

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    level = 2,
    ...restProps
  }: DialogPrimitive.TitleProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- A heading in the heading face; bits-ui renders role="heading" aria-level and names the dialog by it. -->
<DialogPrimitive.Title
  bind:ref
  data-slot="dialog-title"
  {level}
  class={cn("font-heading text-base font-bold", className)}
  {...restProps}
/>

<script lang="ts">
  import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from "bits-ui";
  import { cn } from "$UTILS$";

  let {
    ref = $bindable(null),
    class: className,
    ...restProps
  }: DialogPrimitive.DescriptionProps = $props();
</script>

<DialogPrimitive.Description
  bind:ref
  data-slot="dialog-description"
  class={cn("text-sm text-muted-foreground", className)}
  {...restProps}
/>
